proposals.title: Append-only evidence-event log with inclusion, consistency, and equivocation witnesses
proposals.mission_surface: evidence events, canonical event bytes, append-only ordering, Merkle roots, inclusion proofs, consistency proofs, fork and equivocation detection, receipt publication, provenance, non-substitution, and claim-truth boundaries
proposals.hypothesis: A deterministic local transparency contract can reject deleted, reordered, mutated, or forked evidence events and can distinguish inclusion in an append-only structure from the truth, authority, or external publication of the logged claim.
proposals.null_or_failure: An event changes without a root change, a shorter or forked tree is accepted as a consistent extension, an inclusion proof is counted as scientific support, canonical bytes float, duplicate events masquerade as independent evidence, or a local root is described as a public transparency service.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Mutate event bytes, order, tree size, leaf index, proof path, prior root, canonical encoding, duplicate identity, and claim role; require every inconsistent extension or false-independence case to fail closed while truth and external-publication claims remain false.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Quarantine the divergent branch, retain both roots and the failed vector, restore the last consistent canonical event prefix, and require separately authorized external publication or review before claiming any public transparency property.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Earlier phases covered ancestry, manifests, hash parity, atomic receipts, requirement-evidence traces, citation anchors, redirects, and source aliases; none tested append-only inclusion plus cross-size consistency and explicit equivocation while separating log membership from claim truth.

proposals.title: EFT operator-basis quotient under integration-by-parts and equation-of-motion redundancy
proposals.mission_surface: GMUT typed scalar-tensor and EFT scaffold, operator monomials, derivative placement, integration by parts, equations of motion, total derivatives, field-redefinition limits, basis rank, dimensions, coefficients, and scientific claim boundaries
proposals.hypothesis: A finite synthetic quotient contract can identify deliberately equivalent EFT operator fixtures under declared integration-by-parts and equation-of-motion rewrite rules and can reject duplicate basis claims without asserting a complete GMUT basis.
proposals.null_or_failure: Rewrite rules are undeclared or non-terminating, inequivalent operators collapse, equivalent operators are double counted, dimensions or coefficient orders drift, a total derivative changes an observable in the fixture without notice, or a toy quotient is called a complete healthy theory or empirical result.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Exercise equivalent-by-parts, equivalent-by-declared-EOM, total-derivative, dimension-mismatch, coefficient-order, cyclic-rewrite, undeclared-rule, false-collapse, duplicate-basis, and completeness-promotion fixtures; reject every unsafe basis assertion.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Retain the counterexample, remove only the invalid quotient claim, restore the explicit unreduced operator list and declared rewrite set, and require theory-specific expert derivation and independent scientific review before any completeness claim.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: The chain tested variational traces, field-redefinition orbits, Bianchi exchange, hyperbolicity, kinetic-Hessian rank, constraint closure, and degree-of-freedom counting; it did not quotient an explicit operator list by integration-by-parts and declared equation-of-motion redundancy.

proposals.title: Cutoff hierarchy and EFT truncation-error promotion lock
proposals.mission_surface: GMUT EFT cutoff, expansion parameter, order-by-order coefficients, breakdown scale, truncation remainder, naturalness assumptions, correlations, dimensions, synthetic intervals, real likelihoods, observations, and empirical promotion
proposals.hypothesis: A deterministic synthetic power-counting contract can reject fixtures evaluated at or above their declared cutoff, with missing expansion parameters or inconsistent order labels, and can represent a bounded remainder envelope without claiming a real GMUT uncertainty interval.
proposals.null_or_failure: The expansion parameter is absent or at least one, the evaluation scale exceeds the cutoff, order labels skip silently, coefficient assumptions are hidden, correlations are invented, remainder bounds shrink after a worse coefficient, or a synthetic envelope becomes a real-data likelihood, fit, posterior, or empirical confirmation.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Mutate cutoff, evaluation scale, expansion parameter, order sequence, coefficient magnitude, unit, correlation declaration, remainder monotonicity, real-row count, likelihood count, posterior count, and promotion flags; fail closed outside the declared synthetic envelope.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Retain the failed coefficient or scale fixture, restore the least committal declared cutoff and order list, label the remainder represented only, and require real observations, a preregistered likelihood, validated correlations, and independent review before empirical promotion.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Earlier proposals covered solver tolerances, dimensional typing, prior sensitivity, posterior prediction, calibration covariance, measurement error, and stability; none enforced a declared EFT cutoff and order-by-order truncation remainder with an explicit empirical-promotion lock.

proposals.title: Pre-decode instrument-drift and measurement-invariance gate for THOS
proposals.mission_surface: THOS protocol proxy, outcome instruments, item versions, construct scope, configural and loading structure, threshold or intercept drift, differential item functioning, scoring keys, arm decoding, matched budgets, participants, raters, ethics, and independent review
proposals.hypothesis: A protocol-only synthetic contract can reject an outcome instrument whose item set, construct mapping, scoring key, or preregistered invariance rule changes after arm decoding while reserving real measurement invariance for actual data and review.
proposals.null_or_failure: Items or scoring change after unblinding, the compared construct differs by arm, differential item functioning is ignored, a missing group is treated as invariant, matched budgets diverge, participant or rater counts are fabricated, or synthetic instrument metadata becomes THOS superiority, AGI, ASI, consciousness, or personhood evidence.

proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Prior THOS work covered allocation, power, attrition, carryover, interference, multiplicity, exposure escrow, scorer reliability, safety stopping, protocol deviations, and estimands; none froze instrument structure and measurement-invariance criteria before arm decoding.

proposals.title: Challenge-domain freshness and verifier-audience replay boundary for Freed ID

proposals.title: Burden-of-proof, unknown-state, and evidentiary-silence non-substitution gate
proposals.mission_surface: CBR legitimacy, claim and response states, unknown versus absent versus withheld evidence, burden allocation, adverse inference, standing, remedy, affected-party authority, Māori authority, Māori data governance, cultural ratification, legal interpretation, enacted law, and private material

proposals.title: Floating-point edge-case and comparison-policy replay envelope

proposals.title: Reversibility-class ledger and irreversible-action authority embargo

proposals.null_or_failure: A destructive or deploy action is called reversible, rollback is asserted without evidence, a local owner grants external authority, an account or API-key change is treated as safe-now, a sibling merge bypasses consent, missing review becomes pass, or a structural board becomes Stage 20 readiness.

proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Prior Stage 20 work covered expiry, evidence order, cut sets, non-compensation, contradiction lattices, evidence classes, escrow, asymmetric loss, abstention, and reopening; none made action reversibility, rollback evidence, blast radius, and irreversible external-state authority a single embargo contract.

scientific_authority_boundary: GMUT remains a typed scalar-tensor and EFT research model family; empirical confirmation requires real measurements and likelihood evidence. THOS remains proxy without preregistered blind matched-budget real arms, appropriate ethics and consent, real participants and raters as applicable, validated instruments, and independent review. Freed ID production requires standards-conformant real keys and proofs, live resolution and status, interoperability, privacy assurance, independent security review, and trust governance. CBR, affected-party legitimacy, Māori wording and authority, Māori data governance, cultural ratification, legal interpretation, and enacted-law status remain exact-gated to competent authorities.
claim_boundary: No AGI, ASI, consciousness, sentience, personhood, enacted-law, deployment, exhaustive-security, complete-accessibility, production-readiness, Theory-of-Everything, proof or canon, empirical-confirmation, legal or cultural-ratification, or independent-team-reproduction claim is preregistered as achieved.
